greatpower.why: US–Iran war (since Feb) is paused, not over: US blockade of Iranian ports continues and Trump says 'one or two targets' remain (Pickaxe Mountain) — strikes may resume after the 3 Nov midterms. Russia–NATO and China–Taiwan friction stay below direct clash.
sources: CBS live: Trump suggests more attacks on Iran
Gulf News: Khamenei warns of 'geographically unrestricted' response
Taipei Times: US tells Baltics to cool Russia rhetoric

wars.why: Ukraine: ~300 Russian drones in one day on 31 Oct, Kremlin keeps maximalist demands (a local Kherson ceasefire is holding). Gulf: 81 attacks on ships in Hormuz since 6 Jul; Qatari LNG carrier hit 30 Oct.
sources: ISW: Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment, 31 Oct 2026
Gulf News: Qatari gas tanker struck

nuclear.why: New START expired 5 Feb 2026 — no binding US–Russia limits for the first time in decades. US has threatened to resume testing; no leader-level arms talks. Iran nuclear site still on the US target list.
sources: CFR: Nukes without limits after New START
Reuters: US does not rule out underground tests

mobilization.why: US naval blockade has redirected 144 ships; Iran ordered commanders to update target lists. Around Taiwan it was a 'light day' (13 PLA aircraft, 7 ships), but US Army Pacific keeps the 2027 window 'valid'.

chokepoints.why: Strait of Hormuz effectively closed by Iran; mines reported on the Oman-coast route. Iran offers a 48-hour reopening plan only if its 7 conditions are met.
sources: Israel National News: no reopening until 7 conditions

doomsday.why: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists set the Clock at 85 seconds to midnight on 27 Jan 2026 — the closest ever (89s in 2025). Updated once a year.

changed: Iran offered a 48-hour Hormuz reopening plan via Qatar — a de-escalation signal, but conditional.
Trump: US still has to 'take care of' one or two Iranian targets; Rubio says no decision yet.
Iran's supreme leader orders an 'immediate, geographically unrestricted' response to any attack.
US approves 500 Patriot PAC-3 interceptors for Ukraine (delivery years away).
watch: US midterm elections — Trump has hinted at fresh Iran action after the vote.
Highest risk window: possible resumed US/Israeli strikes vs. Iran's 48-hour Hormuz deal.
Ship attacks / mines in Hormuz and Gulf (UKMTO).
Taiwan MND PLA activity report — watch for jumps above ~30 aircraft.
speculation: Social posts claiming a US ground invasion of Iran is imminent — no official confirmation; Iran's 'killing ground' remarks are a warning, not evidence of an invasion plan.
Iran's claims that ~10 ships hit mines are largely unverified by independent sources.
Reports that China and Russia would 'guarantee' a US–Iran deal come from a single unnamed-source report.
